newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stability pact text may be ready Monday - Zalm.
newsitem.headline: Stability pact text may be ready Monday - Zalm.

text.p: Dutch Finance Minister Gerrit Zalm said on Sunday that an informal meeting of European Union ministers had made good progress on a stability pact and could finalise a text on Monday.
"We made extremely good progress...we will be able to finish a text (on the stability pact) tomorrow," Zalm told a news conference after the dinner meeting.
Italian Finance Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi also said the meeting had been positive, adding that he hoped for an agreement.
Asked whether agreement was possible, he said: "Yes, I hope so. That is what we are working towards," adding that the positions of the 15 EU member countries were "close".
Belgium's Philippe Maystadt said that finance ministers would meet again at 11.00 a.m. (0900 GMT) on Monday to continue their negotiations.

Germany and France, the primary engines behind monetary union, have been at odds over how to help Europe's 18 million unemployed, with France wanting more time to review EMU's stability pact and Bonn demanding that the bloc stay on the fiscal straight and narrow.
